mode.description: Operational mode: 'block' to deny matching traffic, 'monitor' to log only without blocking.

rules_file.description: Absolute path to the file containing domain blocking rules (one rule per line).

allowlist_file.description: Absolute path to the file containing domain patterns that should never be blocked.

log_file.description: Path to the log file. Leave empty to log to stderr instead.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/SSL connections the agent will inspect.

connection_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds for establishing connections during inspection.

use_system_dns.description: If true, use system DNS resolution; if false, use the custom DNS servers list.

custom_dns.description: List of custom DNS server addresses (format: 'IP:port'). Only used when use_system_dns is false.

tls_inspection.description: Whether to enable TLS inspection: 'enabled' or 'disabled'. When enabled, a CA cert/key must be provided.

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to the CA certificate for TLS inspection (PEM format). Required if TLS inspection is enabled.

tls_ca_key.description: Path to the CA private key for TLS inspection (PEM format). Required if TLS inspection is enabled.

rate_limit_rules.description: List of rate-limiting rules to apply per source IP pattern (regex or CIDR).

items.description: Rate limit rule for a specific IP pattern.

requests_per_second.description: Maximum requests per second allowed for this pattern.

blocked_headers.description: List of HTTP headers to block. Headers are matched case-insensitively.

match_type.description: Match strategy: 'exact' for full match, 'prefix' to block any header starting with the name.

blocked_user_agents.description: List of regular expressions to match against User-Agent headers. Matching agents will be blocked.
